notes:
Inbound SMB lead — product team for mid-size D2C marketplace. Signed up self-serve; primary interest is Hosted API (fast time-to-value).

Key context / ask: wants guidance on which model family to start with and how to trade quality vs cost for customer-facing chat + product recs. Testing volumes ~50k monthly requests (chat-type), average prompt ~80 tokens, expected generation ~150-250 tokens. Cost-sensitive: target <$0.01 per end-user session.

Model questions raised during calls:
- 'Should we pick Mistral-instruct for cost and decent quality or Llama-2-13B for safer output?'
- 'Qwen variants looked good for Chinese — what are latency/cost tradeoffs on hosted?'
- 'Any recommended routing/fallback pattern between cheaper small models and high-quality big models for rare complex queries?'

SE notes (Marco): initial smoke tests show Mistral-large gives good quality for product-recommendation prompts and cheaper token cost vs Llama-2-13B; Llama-2-70B overkill and latency high for hosted SMB stack. Qwen-7B handles Chinese well but needs prompt-tuning for domain terms.

Performance & constraints:
- Latency SLO: 95th pct target <200ms for short chat flows; POC currently 95th ~350ms on larger prompts (need batching config / smaller model).
- Throughput: bursts up to 50 tps during marketing spikes — want autoscaling / predictable throttling guidance.
- Quality: incline to start with mid-sized Llama/Mistral family for English, Qwen for Chinese; use Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + quantization to cut cost.

Commercial: SMB budget conservative. Interested in usage-based pricing; might convert to paid after 30-day POC if costs align. Forecasted ARR on conversion small but scalable ($5k-$20k).

Security / compliance: requires SOC2 cert copy and SSO/SAML; retention controls important for user data; public cloud acceptable.

Next-step agreed on call: AE to provide tailored model selection playbook (3 recommended stacks: cost-first, quality-first, hybrid routing) + expected token cost examples for their sample prompt set by 2026-03-12. POC extension if smoke shows latency > target.

Quoted customer comment: 'We need a path that keeps monthly bills predictable — can trade a bit of quality if it halves the bill.'
additional_notes_short: SMB inbound. Self-serve -> discovery. Focus: model selection (Mistral/Llama/Qwen), cost-sensitivity, hosted API POC.
